reason: Hypothesis A proposes a specific, physically sound mechanism (Si-rich glassy phase for liquid-phase sintering and protective barrier) with a clear intervention (3–5 wt% Si), measurable outcomes, and a well-defined falsification experiment, directly addressing the constraints of lower-temperature manufacture and durability.
